integrity_rule: brief 09: frequency only. No P&L, win rate, premium capture or any outcome statistic is computed, stored or reported for any variant.

method.causality: each decision session uses closes sliced to [session-560d, session] and that session's exact cached chain; earnings knowledge is cut at session_close_utc(session)
method.data: cached .cache/chains plus .cache/underlying only; no provider calls
method.error_policy: unavailable symbol-day counts in the denominator and cannot enter
method.measurement_bias_disclosure: B4: measured on ThetaData EOD chains; the forward window would run on Schwab 15:45 pre-close data. Every known simplification inflates counts (see the menu report for direction-by-simplification).
method.portfolio_state_assumption: each historical session starts with no open H7 positions and the full frozen monthly sleeve; same-session board caps apply. This INFLATES counts relative to live operation, where an open position blocks its underlying for the whole holding period.

occupancy_note: entries surviving one-open-position-per-underlying for N sessions. The headline count assumes a flat book every session, which no live window can reproduce; these are the same entries replayed through the registered position cap. Schedule arithmetic only -- no price path, no outcome. Still an upper bound (the monthly sleeve is not netted).
tool_label: cached-only read-only ENTRY-FREQUENCY measurement; no verdict, no outcome statistics of any kind

variant.rule_change: Restrict entries to the 9 names frozen into the registered cohort (the other 6 were excluded for unknown earnings dates at registration).
